notes: pending_exits: positions flagged for exit (SELL_STOP/SELL_TRAIL20/SELL_TIME) or profit-taking (TAKE_PROFIT_2R/3R) for 3+ consecutive trading days with no action taken yet. Exit-category positions are auto-closed at 10 consecutive days (see recent_auto_closes and ITRADELITE_FOLLOWUP_REPORT.md item 4); profit-take positions are never auto-closed.
